impl.name: NO_FLOATING_PARTS
impl.stmt: Every element must be connected to the model.

impl.name: NO_STUD_IN_PINHOLE
impl.stmt: A System stud may not be inserted into a Technic pinhole.

impl.name: NO_FRACTIONAL_ROTATION
impl.stmt: Parts may not be positioned at sub-detent rotations.

impl.name: MATRIX_WELL_FORMED
impl.stmt: The 9 matrix values are ROW-major: (a,b,c) is the first row. (a,d,g) is the image of the X axis.

impl.name: Y_IS_UP_NEGATIVE
impl.stmt: -Y is up. Stack upward by decreasing Y. Part origin sits on the TOP face.

impl.name: MODEL_COLOUR_CONCRETE
impl.stmt: Model type-1 lines use concrete colour codes. Parts use 16. Colour 24 never appears on a type-1 line.

impl.name: GRID_ALIGNMENT
impl.stmt: Placements land on the System's own 2 LDU lattice. The ordinary studs-up lattice is 10 in X/Z and 4 in Y, but SNOT and Technic constructions legitimat

impl.name: MPD_STRUCTURE
impl.stmt: First 0 FILE block is the main model. Blocks are a flat list; nesting is by reference only.

impl.name: NO_DEPRECATED_PARTS
impl.stmt: Do not reference ~Moved to aliases or ~-prefixed hidden parts.

impl.name: PART_NUMBERS_RESOLVED
impl.stmt: Never invent part numbers. Resolve against the real library.

impl.name: FILE_PARSES
impl.stmt: Every line must be a valid LDraw line type with the correct token count and numeric fields.

ready.name: SNOT_LOGO_CLEARANCE
ready.stmt: Nothing may be placed against the face a stud points into; the moulded wordmark adds ~0.14 mm to every stud.

ready.name: MASONRY_BOND
ready.stmt: Courses must overlap; vertical seams must not repeat between adjacent courses.

ready.name: RECEIVER_SMALLER_THAN_CONNECTOR
ready.stmt: The receiving element must not be smaller than what is pushed into it.

ready.name: MULTI_STUD_INTO_TECHNIC_HOLES
ready.stmt: Never more than one stud into Technic holes.

ready.name: TECHNIC_HOLE_BRIDGED
ready.stmt: A System stud in a Technic hole may not be bridged.

ready.name: CLICK_HINGE_OFF_DETENT
ready.stmt: Click hinges may only be set at multiples of 22.5 degrees.

ready.name: PIN_NOT_IN_CLICK
ready.stmt: Every Technic pin must be seated in its detent.

ready.name: SYSTEM_TECHNIC_HEIGHT_MISMATCH
ready.stmt: System side-studs and Technic holes are not co-planar.

ready.name: STUD_IN_TECHNIC_HOLE_UNBRIDGED
ready.stmt: A single unbridged stud in a Technic hole is technically legal but not recommended.

ready.name: OUT_OF_SYSTEM_HEIGHT
ready.stmt: Hinge-plate height mismatch puts subsequent geometry out of system.

ready.name: NO_BFC_IN_MODELS
ready.stmt: Emit no BFC statements in a model file. They are for part files.

ready.name: MEASURED_SLOPE_ANGLES
ready.stmt: Slope part NAMES are systematically wrong. Use measured geometry.

ready.name: EXACT_ROTATIONS_ARE_RATIONAL
ready.stmt: For Pythagorean-triple rotations, emit the exact rational cos/sin, never cos(36.87 deg).

ready.name: ONLY_N4_CLOSES
ready.stmt: Only theta in {0,90,180,270} maps the stud lattice onto itself. N=4 is the ONLY exactly-closing rosette.

ready.name: CURVED_SLOPES_ARE_ELLIPTICAL
ready.stmt: Every curved slope in the System is elliptical; none is circular.

ready.name: NEVER_FORCE_A_BOW
ready.stmt: Never shorten a run to force a curve.

ready.name: LOAD_BUDGET
ready.stmt: Stud engagement must be budgeted against hanging mass.

ready.name: TILES_ARE_SLIP_PLANES
ready.stmt: Never place a tile in a load path.

ready.name: SNOT_COMMENSURABILITY
ready.stmt: A SNOT sandwich must return to the grid.

ready.name: BRACKET_NOT_COMMENSURATE
ready.stmt: 1x2 bracket child face offset from the parent edge is 12 LDU — NOT grid-commensurate.

blocked.name: MUST_BE_SEPARABLE
blocked.stmt: No construction that cannot be taken apart again.

blocked.name: NO_BENDING
blocked.blocked: unrepresentable in plain LDraw (a bent part has no distinct encoding)
blocked.stmt: Only parts designed to flex may be bent.

blocked.name: TECHNIC_SMOOTHNESS
blocked.stmt: Working mechanisms must not stress elements.

blocked.name: SUBMISSION_LIMITS
blocked.stmt: Part count, palette and part-economy limits apply to submissions.

blocked.name: PLATE_BETWEEN_STUDS
blocked.stmt: A plate may not be wedged edge-on between two studs.

blocked.name: CONE_ON_PIN_NO_STOP
blocked.stmt: No press-fitting an element that has no travel stop.

blocked.name: PIN_INTO_UNDERSIZED_BORE
blocked.stmt: Pins must not be forced into non-Technic bores.

blocked.name: PC_ON_PC_SLIDING
blocked.blocked: part-property table: PC vs ABS materials
blocked.stmt: Polycarbonate must not slide against polycarbonate.

blocked.name: TECHNIC_HALFBEAM_WITH_SYSTEM_PLATE
blocked.blocked: unimplementable as published — source lacks a precise condition

blocked.name: ORIGIN_NOT_COMPUTED
blocked.stmt: Do not compute part origin as the centroid of its footprint. Use a per-part table.

legal.name: TILE_BETWEEN_STUDS
legal.stmt: A tile wedged between two studs is LEGAL. Contrast L-10, which is the same geometry with a plate.

legal.name: CLIP_ON_TILE
legal.stmt: Clipping onto a tile is legal on modern clip mouldings.

legal.name: FIVE_PLATES_EQUALS_TWO_STUDS
legal.stmt: The 5-plate / 2-stud SNOT identity is legal and exact (40 LDU).

legal.name: MACARONI_LAW
legal.stmt: Corner-round NxN parts are quarter annuli: R_outer = 20N, R_inner = 20(N-1), wall always exactly 20 LDU.
